metadata.defaultTitle: BroWay Adventures — Travel with clarity and company
metadata.defaultDescription: Travel agency based in Medellín, Colombia. We help you choose your next trip, at home or abroad, with clear options and transparent pricing.

cta.cuentanosComoViajar: Tell us how you'd like to travel

microcopy.respuestaEnMinutos: We reply in minutes, no strings attached
microcopy.asesoraExperto: A travel expert helps you, not a bot
microcopy.precioClaro: Clear final price before you book

whatsapp.mensajeGenerico: Hi, I'd like some help planning a trip

footer.proposito: Making travel feel clearer, closer and more possible.
footer.escnna: We reject the commercial sexual exploitation of children and adolescents. Law 679 of 2001.
footer.antifraude: Before paying, check any agency's RNT in Colombia's National Tourism Registry. We're happy to walk you through it.

precio.verificadaEl: Rate verified on {fecha}, subject to availability and reconfirmation.
precio.consultaCondiciones: See conditions, taxes and included services.

destinos.introListado: Six destinations we know well. If yours isn't here, message us: we also build trips to order.
destinos.sinResultados: No destinations of that type right now.
destinos.sinPlanes: We don't have a published trip for this destination right now. Message us and we'll build one around your dates.
destinos.mensajeWhatsapp: Hi, I'd like information about travelling to {destino}

paquetes.tituloListado: Trips already put together and ready to go
paquetes.introListado: Every trip comes with its price explained, what's included and what isn't. If you want other dates or another departure city, we adjust it.
paquetes.vacio: No trips published right now. Message us and we'll put one together with you.
paquetes.itinerarioNota: A summary of the route. Your advisor sends the full detail with the quote.
paquetes.formasPagoTexto: Hold it with 30% and pay the rest in instalments. Payment is arranged with an advisor on WhatsApp, who confirms the final amount before charging anything.
paquetes.formulario: Would you rather we write to you?
paquetes.formularioTexto: Leave us your details and an advisor replies with the options for this trip.
paquetes.relacionados: Other trips that might suit you
paquetes.mensajeWhatsapp: Hi, I'd like a quote for the {titulo} trip

oferta.vencidaTitulo: This rate is no longer valid
oferta.vencidaTexto: It was valid until {fecha}. We'll put together an updated one, for the same dates or whichever you prefer.
oferta.vencidaCta: Ask us for an updated rate
oferta.vencidaMensajeWhatsapp: Hi, I saw the {titulo} trip on the website and the rate has expired. Could you put together an updated one?

formulario.telefonoAyuda: Include your country code if you're outside Colombia
formulario.ciudadOrigenAyuda: Where you travel from. The price changes with the city.
formulario.fechaAproximadaAyuda: If you're not sure yet, leave it blank
formulario.enviar: Tell us how you'd like to travel
formulario.error: We couldn't send your request. Try again or message us on WhatsApp.
formulario.microcopyEnvio: A travel expert helps you, not a bot.

gracias.expectativa: We'll message you on WhatsApp during business hours. An advisor reviews your request and replies with clear options.
gracias.paso1: An advisor reviews what you told us and puts together options for your trip.
gracias.paso2: They message you on WhatsApp with prices and the full conditions.
gracias.paso3: If something doesn't fit, you adjust it together before booking anything.
gracias.mensajeWhatsapp: Hi, I just left my details on the website and I'd like to move forward with a quote
gracias.mensajeWhatsappConDestino: Hi, I just left my details on the website about the trip to {destino} and I'd like to move forward with a quote

consentimiento.texto: I authorise BroWay Adventures to process my personal data in order to handle my request, prepare travel quotes, follow up, and send me commercial information and personalised advertising via WhatsApp, phone and email, in accordance with the Data Protection Policy.
consentimiento.derechos: I may access, update and delete my data, and withdraw this authorisation, through the channels stated in the policy.
consentimiento.requerido: We need your authorisation in order to contact you.

error.noEncontradoTexto: The link may have changed. Take a look at our destinations, or message us and we'll point you in the right direction.
